title: Bme Caden 15" Bed Frame Queen Caramel
amazon_match_notes: Woot offer Asin B0BWW41YS1 matches Bme Caden 15'' Bed Frame 2, Queen, Caramel, model QBH22, UPC 810127112858. Near-identical QBH21 caramel queen listings used for market price.
writeup: The Bme Caden queen bed frame in caramel is $99.99 at Woot with a three-per-customer limit and only a few left. Verified market checks put the cheapest matching listing at ShopAbunda for $180.98 and Wholesale Mattress Warehouse at $237.98 for the same mid-century acacia style with an adjustable headboard and twelve wood slats. That is about 44% below the lowest verified store price, with solid acacia construction and no box spring needed.
